about: What every setting of a run means, in a line. The book's runs blocks show each run's value beside these words; the note book/notes/settings.md explains each at length.

total_tokens.meaning: The number of tokens in the world, *T*. It never changes during a run.

n_nodes.meaning: How many founders the world starts with. 0 means one founder per hundred tokens: *n* = ⌊*T* / 100⌋.

k_neighbors.meaning: How many neighbours each founder starts with in the ring. 0 means *k* = max(⌊*n* / 100⌋, 5); an odd *k* is wired as *k* − 1.

rewire_p.meaning: In the starting ring, the probability that a connection is moved to a founder chosen at random (Watts–Strogatz).

hidden_layers.meaning: The widths of the brain's hidden layers, in order from input to output.

brain_kind.meaning: How weights are stored: `float` (64-bit), `float16` (16-bit, computed in 64-bit) or `binary` (−1, 0, +1).

brain_bits.meaning: Only for binary brains: how many input rows encode one number. Unused by float and float16 brains.

message_amount.meaning: How many numbers one message holds. Each agent sends one message to itself and one to each neighbour, every phase.

random_input_amount.meaning: How many random numbers, drawn uniformly from −2 to 2, a brain reads per neighbour, every time it looks.

exchange_messages.meaning: Whether agents send and read messages at all.

message_prepass.meaning: Whether every phase begins with an extra look in which agents only write messages, so the look that acts reads messages written this phase.

allow_handover.meaning: Whether a parent may move some of its own connections to its newborn child.

allow_revolutions.meaning: Whether a coalition of smaller stakers can take a node from its largest staker (see the note *How a coalition takes a node*).

allow_gifting.meaning: Whether agents may give tokens to neighbours during reproduction. Off in every run of this book.

random_decisions.meaning: The control: every number a brain would produce is replaced by a random draw from the standard normal distribution.

prune_after.meaning: After which phase connections that carried no tokens are cut: `blotto` (the game), `reproduction`, or `both`.

inactive_window.meaning: How long a connection may go unused: `phase` means it must carry tokens in the phase being judged; `iteration` allows the two last phases.

redistribution.meaning: How the tokens of removed agents are shared: `uniform` gives every survivor the same chance at each token; `by_tokens` weights by what a survivor holds; `poorest` raises the poorest to one common level first; `newborns` gives them to this iteration's children, `parents` to their parents, once per child (both `uniform` in an iteration without births); `children` leaves each dead agent's estate to its own living children (`uniform` where there are none).

tokens_created_per_phase.meaning: Tokens added to the world at every cleanup. 0 keeps the supply fixed.

mutation_probability.meaning: The probability that a brain changes when it is copied to a child, and again, for every brain, after every game.

mutation_noise_std.meaning: How large a change to one weight is: a normal draw with standard deviation this times 1/√(fan-in) of its layer.

mutation_sparsity.meaning: The share of a brain's numbers a change touches; also the probability, for each weight matrix and bias vector, of a rarer reset that redraws that share of it.

extinction_threshold.meaning: A run stops, as extinct, when an iteration ends (after its game) with this many agents or fewer.

mutate_on_replication.meaning: Whether a brain changes only when it is copied — into a newborn, or into a node its owner has just won — instead of also after every game, wherever it sits.

incumbency.meaning: How many times over an agent's stake on its own node counts when the game decides who takes the node. 1 is the old rule.

birth_links.meaning: How many of its parent's neighbours a newborn is joined to, drawn at random, besides its parent itself; 0 leaves every link to the brain's choice.

mend_on_death.meaning: Whether the neighbours of an agent that dies are joined up where its death would leave them in separate pieces.

prune_needs.meaning: How many neighbours the two ends of an unused connection must share for it to be cut; 0 cuts every unused connection.

valence.meaning: The most connections an agent's brain may choose to hold (0 = no limit). An agent at its limit cannot have a child.

max_age.meaning: The age at which an agent dies (0 = never); its tokens are shared out like those of any other dead agent.

min_child.meaning: The fewest tokens a child can be born with; a parent that would give less has no child.

keep_home.meaning: The share of an agent's tokens — rounded up, never less than one — that stays on its own node whatever its brain says; a parent also keeps one. 0 is the old rule.

mix_at_birth.meaning: Whether a newborn's brain is its parent's mixed with a mate's — one of the parent's neighbours, drawn at random — each hidden unit whole from one or the other by an even chance, before it mutates; off, a newborn has a copy of its parent's brain.

link_search.meaning: Whether an agent may reach beyond its neighbours to propose a link: off; jump, a walk as many steps long as the tokens it spends in one iteration, with a link proposed where it ends; walk, a scout that goes one step further in every iteration it pays for; or reach, a jump whose steps are free, as many as the tokens it holds would pay for. A paid step costs one token, paid to the agent it enters, and never the last.

link_steering.meaning: Which way each step of a search goes: to a neighbour drawn at random, or to the one the searcher would most like a link with (looking).

link_consent.meaning: Who has to agree to a link a search proposes: both ends (mutual), or only the one who proposes (forced). Nobody at its valence gets a new link either way.

buy_life.meaning: Whether an agent that has reached max_age may live on by paying one token an iteration into the estate of the dead — never its last, so one with a single token left dies. Needs max_age.

mix_mates.meaning: Under mix_at_birth, who may be the mate: any neighbour of the parent, or only parents — a neighbour with a living child of its own (with none, the newborn's brain is a copy).

self_message.meaning: What an agent writes to itself, which each neighbour reads: what its own column says (own), or the largest, number by number, of what it writes to anyone (largest), so that news one column marks reaches every neighbour.
